warning_text:
GOVERNMENT WARNING:(1) ACCORDING TO THE SURGEON GENERAL,
WOMEN SHOULD NOT DRINK ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES DURING PREG-
NANCY BECAUSE OF THE RISK OF BIRTH DEFECTS. (2) CONSUMPTION
OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES IMPAIRS YOUR ABILITY TO DRIVE A CAR
OR OPERATE MACHINERY, AND MAY CAUSE HEALTH PROBLEMS.
notes: The brand lockup on the front is set on two lines: 'SALTIRE' in display size over 'RARE MALT WHISKY COMPANY' in small capitals. Both lines are transcribed as the printed brand.
Alcohol prints with no spaces, '48.8%Alc./Vol.', in mixed case, on both the front and the back.
Net contents prints as '700ml' in lower case, followed by the estimated-sign mark; the quantity wording itself is '700ml'.
The warning has no space after the colon: it prints 'GOVERNMENT WARNING:(1) ACCORDING'.
The warning's line break splits 'PREG-NANCY' with a hyphen, so the transcription keeps the printed line breaks.
The warning appears on the back only; the front carries no warning.
